tool_suggestions.title: Retailer Partnership Performance Dashboard
tool_suggestions.prompt: Create a dashboard for employees to analyze the performance of retailer partnerships, focusing on commissions, conversions, and product offerings.
features: View commission summaries and trends over time
Filter by retailer type and partnership status
Analyze conversion rates and sales performance
Track new products added by partner retailers
Generate reports on retailer engagement and contributions

tool_suggestions.title: Customer Interaction Tracker and Analyzer
tool_suggestions.prompt: Build a tool to track and analyze user sessions, interactions, and behavior trends to improve customer understanding and product enhancement.
features: View user sessions with detailed interaction logs
Analyze click-through rates and session durations
Track changes in user behavior over time
Export session data for further analysis

tool_suggestions.title: Product Price Evaluation and Strategy Tool
tool_suggestions.prompt: Design a tool to evaluate product pricing strategies by analyzing price trends, competitor prices, and alert triggers to optimize revenue.
features: Visualize price history and trends for each product
Compare current prices with competitors' pricing
Monitor effectiveness of price drop alerts
Adjust pricing strategies based on historical data
Generate actionable insights for pricing adjustments
